name: final_turnE
note: Locked palette extracted from v2/hair/turnE_final (k-means per material over all 9 views). Boots share the hair ramp (illustration boots are the same dark brown, within 8 levels). Iris uses h/g/L (grey-brown) + K pupil + W glint.

h.desc: hair shadow / inner hair lines / tie line; iris top; boot shadow

g.desc: hair light (tied-top + crown); iris mid; boot light

L.desc: hair sheen band; iris lower light; boot toe glint

S.desc: skin shadow (under bangs, neck, inner legs)

m.desc: mouth, nose dot, inner skin lines, brow

k.desc: blush (skin; cheeks in cheerful/embarrassed/joy/effort expressions only; soft pink on the skin ramp - the illustration cheeks show no distinct blush). Never use dress red for blush

e.desc: red light (bow top, shoulder, sleeve top edge)

R.desc: red shadow (folds, under obi, sleeve inside, bow knot)
